Siri AI is a major upgrade and highlight feature of iOS 27 and later. However, only newer Apple device models can support the fully revamped Siri. Below is the complete hardware list of iPhones, iPads, Macs, Apple Watches, and Apple Vision Pro that support Siri AI.

The following are Apple products that support Siri AI on iOS 27 and later

iOS 27 and its accompanying updates include the long-awaited Siri overhaul, a feature called Siri AI.

Siri AI is only available on compatible hardware (and in specific regions). Below are all the Apple products that support Siri AI.

iPhone

  • iPhone Duo
  • iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone Air
  • iPhone 17
  • iPhone 17e
  • iPhone 16 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone 16 and 16 Plus
  • iPhone 16e
  • iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max

iPad

  • iPad Pro (M1 chip and later models)
  • iPad Air (M1 chip and later models)
  • iPad mini (A17 Pro)

Mac

  • All models equipped with Apple silicon (M1 chip and later, as well as A18 Pro chip)

Apple Watch (must be paired with an AI-capable iPhone for use)

  • Apple Watch Series 9 and later models
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2 and later models
  • Apple Watch SE 3

Apple Vision Pro

  • All models

All the products above support Siri AI. However, some features of the Siri experience will perform better on specific hardware.

For example, the feature that fully customises the rhythm and expressiveness of the Siri AI voice is only available on specific hardware. According to Apple's official explanation:

The reason for this limitation is that Apple's most powerful on-device AI models are only available on newer products. Users with these models may experience faster performance with Siri AI — or they may not.

Will Siri AI prompt you to upgrade to newer Apple hardware? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
